name: flight-route-map
title: Flight Route Map
description: A plane flies a glowing route between two labelled pins over a drawn map, the camera drifts, the destination gets a hand-drawn circle and an arrival badge.
useWhen: A journey from one place to another needs to read at a glance: a trip, a delivery, an expansion.
The scene is an opener or a transition card with a headline.
avoidWhen: The map must show real geography: this draws an abstract map.
You need more than two stops.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
